difficulty_reason: H3: realizing an arbitrary level-zero quasi-character requires a reverse construction beyond the already supplied forward image theorem. The author lifts connected-centralizer nilpotent cuspidal data through full finite-centralizer averaging, proves the new finite twisted functions are cuspidal, controls their support and exact normalization, and reconstructs the required elliptic germs. A separate local-to-global quasi-character filtration argument then glues Levi germs with a conjugation-invariant locally finite partition and uses Weyl-weighted corrections in successive annihilator grades. Only the terminating rank induction upgrades elliptic agreement to a global preimage. The complete new reconstruction and filtration proofs, plus all nonroutine prior core, are supplied.
